findings.reason: All four authentic original-resolution tiles contain formulas and prose but no geometric figure. Side-by-side exact projected strand windows materially clarify the alternating crossings, time order and shared endpoint permutation in this explicitly geometric example; completeness of the existing verification does not remove this expository benefit.
findings.action: Appended an explanatory caption and fenced native TikZ in the existing final Remarks section; draws both braid words with actual under-strand gaps and labelled time breaks and endpoints.

correction: Added a side-by-side x-u projection of W_0 and W_1, preserving the exact piecewise-linear x coordinates and window lengths of Verification 1.1. The caption defines the viewing direction and crossing convention, right-factor-first stacking, strand labels and isotopy relation.

diagram_math_checks.check: Each pictured strand represents u -> ((W_j)_k(u),u) in D° × [0,1], projected to its first spatial coordinate x and height u. Drawing columns X=0,1,2 mean x=-2h,0,2h, with h=1/16; drawing height Y=4u. The local definition gives rho_1(v)=2hv-h on both branches, hence straight diagonal projected exchanges are exact, with the untouched third strand vertical. All values remain in D° by unchanged Verification 2.1; projected crossings are not physical collisions.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Temporal order and exact break heights
diagram_math_checks.check: The stacking supplier places the right factor first. For W_0=σ1⋆(σ2⋆σ1), the bottom-to-top generators are σ1,σ2,σ1; for W_1=σ2⋆(σ1⋆σ2) they are σ2,σ1,σ2. Verification 1.1 has windows [0,1/4],[1/4,1/2],[1/2,1], represented by drawing heights [0,1],[1,2],[2,4]. The two lower windows have equal length and the upper window twice that length; the height labels agree.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Six crossings, their signs and over/under data
diagram_math_checks.check: The local positive half-twist definition has rho_2(v)<0 for 0<v<1. Viewing from positive spatial y makes the left-to-right mover m+rho the under-strand, while m-rho is over. Every such ascending-right segment is genuinely interrupted over local v in (0.41,0.59), with the ascending-left segment continuous. Crossings occur at u=1/8,3/8,3/4. In W_0 the under/over strand-label pairs are 1/2,1/3,2/3; in W_1 they are 2/3,1/3,1/2. All six are the positive σ_i specified by the local definition, with no inverse crossings.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Exact strand positions at the joins and endpoint permutation
diagram_math_checks.check: Read spatial columns left to right. W_0 has strand-label rows (1,2,3) at u=0, (2,1,3) at u=1/4, (2,3,1) at u=1/2, and (3,2,1) at u=1. W_1 has (1,2,3), (1,3,2), (3,1,2), (3,2,1). These are exactly the tuples in Verification 1.1; both send strand 1 to q3, 2 to q2 and 3 to q1, as asserted in Verification 2.2. The drawn endpoints are labelled accordingly.

diagram_math_checks.objects: No accidental strand crossings or equality claim
diagram_math_checks.check: In each of the six windows only the two adjacent columns exchange; the third column is strictly outside their closed horizontal interval, so each panel has exactly three projected crossings and no extra ones at a join. The displayed ∼ is the braid isotopy established by F1 and Verification 3.1 through rot; it does not identify projected paths. No interpolation trajectories or generic projection of rot are asserted. Final standalone original-resolution tile shows three clear gaps in each panel and distinct endpoint, time and generator labels.
